headline: Sets the order of officials who would lead the Department of Agriculture if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order sets an order of succession for the U.S. Department of Agriculture. That means it lists which officials would step in to act as Secretary of Agriculture if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or cannot do the job. No summary was provided, so details such as which officials are listed and in what order are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Agriculture
who_it_affects.how: They are placed in a set order for who would temporarily take over as acting Secretary if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 21, 2012; the source does not state a separate effective date.
